resumeText:
Anita Verma | Mumbai | anita.verma@example.com

SUMMARY
Risk leader with 20 years in credit, portfolio and enterprise risk at banks and NBFCs.

EXPERIENCE
Head of Risk, Deccan Finserv (NBFC), Mumbai (2019 - present)
- Built the enterprise risk management framework and the board-approved risk appetite statement.
- Oversaw credit risk modelling for retail and MSME scorecards and IFRS 9 ECL.
- Set up operational risk management with RCSA and loss data for all branches.
- Led compliance with RBI master directions on scale based regulation and the CRO role.
- Run early warning signals and NPA monitoring for the loan book.
- Report to the board risk committee every quarter.
- Managed a team of 40 across credit, operational and fraud risk.
- Use stakeholder communication to challenge business growth plans.

Senior Credit Risk Manager, Indus Valley Bank, Mumbai (2010 - 2019)
- Approved large corporate and SME credit and reviewed portfolio concentration.

Credit Analyst, Indus Valley Bank, Mumbai (2006 - 2010)

CERTIFICATIONS
FRM

EDUCATION
MBA Finance, IIM Lucknow, 2006
